Run from the repository root. Authoring tools only; never part of tests/CI.
Observed producer: LibreOffice 26.8.1.1 (AARCH64), writer_pdf_Export.
Python: 3.12; fonttools 4.61.1.

1. Create a fresh absolute AUTHORING directory outside the checkout.
2. python3 internal/core/testdata/corpus/sources/prepare_office_font.py "$AUTHORING/fonts/CorpusNotoSans-Regular.ttf"
   Create the fonts directory first. This transient derivative changes only name
   records in the authoritative bundled Noto Sans so exporter font selection is
   unambiguous. The Noto copyright, OFL and outlines remain intact. Do not commit
   a second standalone Noto font. Font software remains under its original OFL.
3. Create "$AUTHORING/fonts.conf" with an absolute local dir element pointing to
   "$AUTHORING/fonts" and a cachedir under AUTHORING. This generated config is
   private authoring state, not provenance or a corpus source.
4. FONTCONFIG_FILE="$AUTHORING/fonts.conf" soffice \
   -env:UserInstallation="file://$AUTHORING/profile" --headless \
   --convert-to 'pdf:writer_pdf_Export:{"ExportBookmarks":{"type":"boolean","value":"true"}}' \
   --outdir "$AUTHORING" internal/core/testdata/corpus/sources/office-report.fodt
5. Review actual embedded fonts (CorpusNotoSans-Regular only), two pages, native
   bookmarks/link, table/vector content, all source/export metadata and renders.
   Replace the frozen office-report.pdf only after review and provenance refresh.

Only original fictional source content is included. No linked graphics, comments,
tracked edits, macros, personal user profile or external fetched resources.
Regeneration is not promised byte-identical across producer/platform upgrades.
